news.headline: X News: Trump Media transfers 4,259 BTC (~$343M) to Crypto.com amid Nov 30 debt deadline
news.detail: X news summary: blockchain trackers saw Trump Media move over 4,000 Bitcoin (about $343M) to Crypto.com in two batches this week from wallets labeled as collateral for 2028 convertible notes, emptying most of those addresses ahead of a Nov 30 holder cash-repayment option on ~$1B notes. No sales confirmed; firm still holds roughly 14,139 BTC total. Chatter ties timing to post-midterm stock drops.

The story frames Pump.fun callout USDC payouts as able to outpace direct trade P&L for top callers.

news.detail: @MyDogeVN (7,245 followers, part of the MyDoge wallet group) posted that, effective today, the official @dogecoin account will be managed and operated by MyDogeVN, quoting an earlier announcement. Low engagement so far (34 impressions); not independently confirmed in this sweep.

news.headline: Binance withdrawals: 8 of the 10 "100% backed" coins can now leave the exchange
news.detail: @MTLabResearch (747 followers) posted that ZEC, TON (incl. USDT) and SUI withdrawals are newly open, joining BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP, Base and DOGE already open. Small account, very low engagement (1 impression); unconfirmed by Binance in this sweep.

news.headline: DOGE missing from Binance's "100% backed" list after the hack, while withdrawals keep reopening
news.detail: @ArchibaldBollz (712 followers) noted Dogecoin is not on Binance's list of fully backed coins and that Binance says about 95% of the hack is covered. Separately @greasydaryle (543 followers) posted that withdrawals are reopening after the $6.3B hack and that WIF was up 1.9% with BONK flat. Small accounts, low engagement (4 and 13 impressions).
